description: Curated company x role requirement sets. These are optional refinements layered on top of (role baseline + company profile). Any combination without an entry here is still fully supported - it is composed from the role and company files.

responsibilities: Own ML models end to end from data preparation through production monitoring on AWS
Reduce inference cost and latency for high-traffic services
Partner with science and engineering teams to launch models that move customer metrics
overrides.notes: Amazon ML Engineer screens combine ML depth with production engineering. Cloud deployment evidence is the single most common gap for candidates from an academic or notebook-only background.

responsibilities: Design and operate services that serve high request volumes reliably
Participate in on-call and drive operational improvements
Write design documents and take features from proposal to launch
overrides.notes: SDE loops weight Leadership Principles heavily. Quantified, first-person ownership statements are what the bar raiser looks for on the resume.

responsibilities: Build and operate large-scale data pipelines on AWS
Model curated datasets used by analytics and science teams
Own pipeline SLAs, data quality and cost
overrides.notes: Redshift, Glue and S3 appear in most Amazon data engineering postings; generic ETL experience without cloud specifics scores lower.

responsibilities: Design and implement components of large distributed systems
Uphold code health through review and testing
Analyse and improve algorithmic efficiency of critical paths
overrides.notes: Fundamentals dominate. Framework-heavy resumes without algorithmic substance are the most common Google screen failure.

responsibilities: Design experiments and define metrics that drive launch decisions
Apply statistical and causal methods to observational data
Communicate analysis to engineering and product leadership
overrides.notes: Google data science interviews probe statistics deeply. Resumes that show modelling but no experimentation or inference read as ML engineering instead.

responsibilities: Build AI features on Azure AI and Azure ML for enterprise customers
Apply responsible AI practices including evaluation and grounding
Work across teams to bring AI capability into existing products
overrides.notes: Microsoft weights responsible AI and enterprise readiness alongside model skill - safety and evaluation vocabulary matters here.

responsibilities: Improve ranking and recommendation models measured by online metrics
Run experiments and ship model changes to production traffic
Build feature pipelines that operate at very large scale
overrides.notes: Meta MLE resumes are read for online impact. Offline accuracy alone is a weaker signal than a shipped model with measured metric movement.

responsibilities: Build streaming and batch platforms used across the company
Operate pipelines with high autonomy and strong judgement
Design for resilience at streaming scale
overrides.notes: Netflix hires senior. Early-career candidates should target the strongest possible depth signal on one system rather than breadth.

responsibilities: Optimise training and inference workloads on GPU hardware
Profile and remove bottlenecks in deep learning pipelines
Work close to the metal with CUDA and C++
overrides.notes: Performance numbers are the currency here. A speedup with a before/after benchmark outweighs a long framework list.

responsibilities: Build software that meets a very high quality and performance bar
Debug complex issues across the stack, sometimes down to hardware
Collaborate with design and hardware teams
overrides.notes: Apple prefers specialists with visible craft. Depth beats breadth in every section of the resume.

responsibilities: Design and deliver hybrid cloud solutions for enterprise clients
Automate provisioning and enforce security and compliance controls
Engage directly with client engineering teams
overrides.notes: Client-facing evidence and certifications carry unusual weight in IBM screens compared with product companies.

responsibilities: Bring generative and vision models into creative product surfaces
Balance model quality against interactive latency budgets
Work closely with designers on how AI features feel to use
overrides.notes: A public demo or portfolio link materially improves Adobe screening outcomes for AI roles.
